model: softflowd NetFlow v9 / IPFIX probe and pmacctd sfprobe (sFlow v5 agent) on Alpine Linux 3.20, exporting IPv6 traffic

capture.image: alpine:3.20 (+ apk on the exporter: softflowd 1.1.0-r0, pmacct 1.7.8-r1, tcpdump 4.99.4-r1, curl 8.14.1-r2, busybox-extras; on the receiver: tcpdump 4.99.4-r1; on the web target: busybox-extras for httpd)
capture.command: exporter (fd00:f1ab::5 / 192.168.144.5): tcpdump -i eth0 -U -w traffic.pcap 'ip6 host fd00:f1ab::7 and (tcp port 80 or udp port 5514)'; pmacctd -f sfprobe.conf (sfprobe_receiver 192.168.144.6:6343, sampling_rate 1, same pcap filter); 3x curl -6 http://[fd00:f1ab::7]/blob.bin (64 KiB, busybox httpd), 1x curl -6 http://[fd00:f1ab::7]/index.html, 4x echo 'openmap flow lab datagram N' | nc -u -w1 fd00:f1ab::7 5514; then softflowd -d -r traffic.pcap -v 9 -n 192.168.144.6:2056 and -v 10 -n 192.168.144.6:2057. Receiver (192.168.144.6): tcpdump -i eth0 -U -w netflow-v9.pcap 'udp dst port 2056' (2057 -> ipfix.pcap, 6343 -> sflow-v5.pcap). NetFlow v5 cannot carry IPv6 and was not run.
capture.network: dedicated dual-stack docker bridge fxlab-h6 (fd00:f1ab::/64 ULA and 192.168.144.0/20); flows are IPv6, the exports travel over IPv4

files.name: netflow-v9.pcap
files.description: softflowd NetFlow v9 export datagram (Ethernet / IPv4 / UDP) with an IPv6 template (fields 27/28) and 12 data records

files.name: ipfix.pcap
files.description: softflowd IPFIX (version 10) export datagram with an IPv6 template and 12 data records

files.name: sflow-v5.pcap
files.description: pmacctd sfprobe sFlow v5 datagrams exported live: one raw-packet-header flow sample per IPv6 packet (sampling rate 1)

files.name: traffic.pcap
files.description: the IPv6 traffic both exporters accounted (ground truth): 4 HTTP connections (84 packets, 203846 IPv6 octets) and 4 UDP datagrams (304 octets)

files.name: softflowd-v9.log
files.description: softflowd's own statistics for the v9 export run

files.name: softflowd-v10.log
files.description: softflowd's own statistics for the IPFIX export run

notes: Same procedure as the batch-1 IPv4 fixtures (softflowd-softflowd-1.1.0, pmacct-pmacctd-sfprobe-1.7.8): softflowd 1.1.0 does not dispatch live packets with libpcap 1.10, so it exported from the live-recorded traffic with its -r mode; pmacct exported live. Addresses are a ULA lab prefix and private IPv4.
